policy: Existing selected concepts replaced; no new gallery variants. Original game captures remain local references. Camera compositions are references, scene lighting/materials are concept renders; no Unity project changes.

Deliverable: one sharp 16:9 PC gameplay UI concept screenshot, ideally 1920x1080, no browser chrome.
Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and immutable camera/composition map: actual Blood & Beans cafe third-person camera. Preserve exact elevated rear camera, lens/perspective, the player at bottom center, all counters, room-wall silhouette, floor boundary, pots and customer counter positions. Image 2 is the STYLE MASTER for EVERY UI piece: existing manufacturing/completion concept. Image 3 is the CHARACTER and overall art-quality reference: squat cream vampire with dark cape/red collar. Image 4 is the actual HotAmericano model: simple handleless white rounded cup with dark coffee. Primary request: Replace the current mismatched gameplay UI with one cohesive Luigi's Mansion 3 inspired haunted-hotel UI belonging to the same set as images 2 and 3. Scene composition stays image 1. Scene surfaces can have soft stylized 3D shading and warm/cool lighting refinement to harmonize with UI, but no geometric change. UI style must have image 2's sculpted chunky cream lettering with a dark outline and short raised warm-brown extrusion, physical cream clipboards with a single brass clip, thick soft carved dark-green panel rims, restrained worn brass corner hardware, clear warm contact shadows. NOT generic flat web UI or random gold ornate plaques. Controlled ghost-green selection glow, warm cream and deep forest green. No decorative filigree or repetitive motifs. PC HUD compactness; scene remains 75% visible.
Place matching small four-team standings panel top-left with lines "팀 1  5G", "팀 2  0G", "팀 3  0G", "팀 4  0G"; active team green. Top-center small raised green timer with sculpted green alarm-clock icon, cream number "00:38", small "1일차 / 7". Top-right small brass coin and "5 / 50G", label "매출 목표". Three small cream dimensional order bubbles above customers at their target positions, simple 3D cake and handleless cup icons, ONE small gold price tab each "17", "35", "35", subtle patience fill inside bubbles, not separate progress bars.
Manufacturing focus: ONE cream brass-clipped manufacturing card to the right of player's held cup, around x 65%, y 48%; not a giant central column. Green raised title "조리 가능" on a warm yellow status pill; name "아메리카노"; simple actual handleless coffee cup in card, bean ingredient badge below, small keycap "F". Just below this card put a modest wide dark-green physical timing gauge matching image 2 bottom-left gauge (approximately x63%, y70%, width27%); label "완성 타이밍", red-yellow-green-yellow-red segments and a white needle, small "MISS  GOOD  PERFECT  GOOD  MISS". Adjacent small raised green "PERFECT!" feedback without obstructing player.
Bottom-left small blue ghost-flame skill medallion and "Q"; bottom-right discrete "F1  조합법". NO bag anywhere in daytime. Avoid large sheet title or five state comparison cards. Every UI element rendered with the SAME physical materials, edge treatment, icon camera, typographic finish and light source as style master. This is a cohesive game screenshot, not a diagram. Sharp legible Korean, no watermark.
